title: Cambridge City Council votes to temporarily restore controversial ShotSpotter gunshot detection technology
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Cambridge City Council voted 6-3 to temporarily reinstate ShotSpotter in areas previously used after the July 4 shooting incident.
The decision allows 90 days for a resident assembly to review the technology and recommend future actions on its usage.
Supporters view ShotSpotter as crucial for quick emergency response, while critics question its accuracy and privacy implications.

title: 4 takeaways from Craig Breslow’s Red Sox trade-deadline press conference
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Red Sox acquired Adley Rutschman from Orioles, trading Carlos Narvaez and several prospects including Anthony Eyanson and Kyson Witherspoon.
Marcelo Mayer was traded to the Giants for lefty reliever Erik Miller, amid concerns over Mayer's durability and performance.
Top prospect Franklin Arias could fill Boston's shortstop role, impacting decisions around Mayer's trade and prospects at the position.

title: ‘Playbook of destruction’: Markey, Moulton meet for combative second debate ahead of Sept. primary
author: Ross Cristantiello
bullets: Sen. Ed Markey and Rep. Seth Moulton engaged in a heated primary debate moderated by Kerry Kavanaugh and Adam Reilly.
The candidates focused on age, military spending, and the definition of progressivism, with both attacking each other's records.
Moulton apologized for past comments on transgender athletes, while Markey denied links to Jeffrey Epstein, calling Moulton's claims reprehensible.

title: 4 unproven Patriots players who are standing out at training camp
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Eli Raridon, a rookie tight end, is emerging as a key target in Patriots training camp following Julian Hill's injury.
Tanner Arkin, an undrafted free agent, is proving valuable as a blocker in New England's run game during training camp.
Karon Prunty and Khalil Jacobs show potential for Patriots defense, with notable performances and versatility in training camp.

title: After jokes on GBH, state senator says agritourism like corn mazes are serious business
author: Ross Cristantiello
bullets: Massachusetts Senator Jo Comerford proposed a $5 million amendment supporting agritourism in an economic development bill.
Comerford criticized jokes made by GBH hosts about the need for more corn mazes as downplaying serious agricultural issues.
Comerford's amendment, part of the 'fun agenda', passed to help struggling farmers diversify through cultural activities.

title: Red Sox trade Marcelo Mayer to Giants for reliever Erik Miller
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Red Sox trade shortstop Marcelo Mayer to San Francisco Giants for lefty reliever Erik Miller and minor leaguer Carlos Gutierrez.
Mayer, struggling with injuries, played 114 games for Boston, batting .223 over parts of two seasons.
Erik Miller strengthens Red Sox bullpen; he had a 2.76 ERA in 38 appearances with the Giants this season.

title: Patriots sign former Giants defensive tackle Casey Rogers
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: The New England Patriots have signed 27-year-old defensive tackle Casey Rogers, who previously played for the Giants and Bills.
Rogers, a 6-foot-4, 300-pound player, appeared in two games for the Giants in 2024 and blocked a kick.
He recorded 21 tackles and 1.5 sacks with the UFL's DC Defenders last spring, losing in the United Bowl.

title: 5 things to know about new Red Sox catcher Adley Rutschman
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: The Red Sox acquired catcher Adley Rutschman from the Orioles, sending Carlos Narvaez and prospects in exchange.
Rutschman, 28, is a former No. 1 MLB Draft pick with a .251 batting average and eight home runs this season.
Rutschman has battled injuries, including a sprained ankle, but boosts Boston's defense and is under control through 2027.

title: 5 takeaways from Day 8 of Patriots training camp
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Patriots wide receiver A.J. Brown played through a dislocated thumb, completing practice and scoring multiple touchdowns.
Undrafted cornerback Channing Canada impressed with pass breakups and participated in kickoff returns during Patriots training camp.
Rookie linebacker Gabe Jacas showed eagerness and learning ability, participating actively during practice and classroom sessions.

title: Ballot Brief: Your guide to the 2026 midterms
author: Zipporah Osei
bullets: Ballot Brief offers coverage of Massachusetts' 2026 midterms, including governor's race and U.S. Senate contests.
The newsletter provides information on nine statewide ballot questions and key candidate debate takeaways.
Early voting starts August 22, with primaries on September 1 in Massachusetts.
